test_title: PYST 2: SSC MTS 2022 - English (Held On: 02 May 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Improve the underlined part of the sentence. Choose 'No improvement' as an answer if the sentence is grammatically correct.

We went to the mall; however, __us only gone__ window -shopping.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 2'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The correct improvement is option 2)** "we only went".**
 
• This** sentence implies** that the speaker and their group visited the mall, but they merely window-shopped
 
• The phrase **"us only gone"** is grammatically incorrect.
 
• The **correct grammar structure** for *past simple is subject + past simple verb*. So "**we only went"** is the right form.

Therefore, the **correct sentence** is: *"We went to the mall; however, we only went window-shopping."*
